messages:
elena: quick sync: product approved a phased deprecation for v1. plan = small banners + redirects -> v2 compatibility pages + concise migration guide. targeting 2026-04-15 for staging redirect.

samir: ok. split work: banners/i18n, redirect rules, auth gotchas for SDKs, ops rollout checklist. who volunteers?

anya: i'll take banner copy + translations (en/fr/ja/es). will keep microcopy only. need exact text to include.

elena: include: "Planned deprecation: v1 API. Migrate to v2 by 2026-05-15." keep <120 chars and a CTA to /docs/v2/migrate-v1.

michael: heads-up: Go SDK trims auth differently. some clients fail if header has extra whitespace or missing "Bearer " prefix. i'll add a docs note + example and a unit test in the Go repo.

michael: suggested snippet for docs:```
// Go: normalize Authorization header
req.Header.Set("Authorization", strings.TrimSpace("Bearer "+token))
resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
```

samir: add small Python example too: `req.headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {token.strip()}"`. also propose using 302 for initial staged redirects so we can measure before switching to 301.

elena: ops wants an exact nginx mapping for staging with analytics param. proposed snippet:```
location ~ ^/docs/v1/(.*)$ {
  return 302 /docs/v2/compat/$1?deprecated=v1;
}
```

ops-bot: Created task OPS-3987: staged-redirects + banner rollout. ETA staging deploy 2026-04-08. Assigned to elena.

anya: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5233  banners + i18n.

michael: will open Go SDK PR linking docs PR and adding test. aiming for Monday.

samir: checklist to add in PR descriptions: banners merged, docs auth note added, Go SDK patch merged, staging nginx applied, smoke test old links redirect & banner visible, analytics param observed for 48h.

elena: i'll run smoke tests and sign off to flip to public redirect on 2026-04-15. flip to permanent 301 after 2 weeks if metrics are clean. update thread when PRs merge. :thumbsup:
